stories.h: Tacoma council restores some officer jobs in budget work
stories.s: Facing a $40 million deficit, the council kept five of 10 community service officer jobs through 2028 and approved $450,000 for behavioral health case management. The HOPE team is still slated for elimination.

stories.h: Tacoma Arts Live deal keeps historic armory open
stories.s: After saying it would sell the armory to cover about $3 million in debt, the nonprofit is restructuring through receivership and dropping national touring shows to focus on education and local artists.

coming.h: Tacoma council expected to adopt 2027-28 budget
coming.s: The council plans this week to adopt a balanced two-year budget closing a $40 million deficit; NWPB reports the vote for Nov. 18, so check the city agenda for timing.
